title: Welcome messages for everyone who joined in the last 30 days
prompt: Eight people joined in the last 30 days (see the joined column in members.csv). Draft a welcome message for each of them and I'll paste them into WhatsApp. ledger.csv has our past intros.

rubric.text: It correctly identifies the eight members who joined since 31 Aug 2026: Kasper Olufsen, Ximena Braithwaite, Obadiah Lennox, Isidore Kamara, Petra Hollingsworth, Ravindra Tuckett, Marguerite Olsson-Pike and Ulrich Amadi.
Each welcome is built around one named member to meet, rather than being a generic welcome.
No new member is steered to a colleague (Kasper Olufsen must not be matched with Ifeoma Adeyemi-Brandt).
Messages are labelled drafts, the manager reviews them before anything goes out, and nothing is claimed to be sent.
It treats these as individual messages, not one broadcast, and mentions pacing or the cap of roughly one proactive touch per member per week.

For new members with no recorded activity yet (Ravindra Tuckett, Marguerite Olsson-Pike, Ulrich Amadi) it still uses a named person from their asks/offers or proposes the three profile questions, without inventing facts about them.
No email address or phone number appears in the messages.
